purpose: Prospective small-order SPY/QQQ execution-cost scenarios derived without strategy-return access.

derivation.reference: Latest eligible SIP quote strictly before each frozen one-second grid point.
derivation.per_fill_cost: Adverse half of the quoted spread for the traded symbol.
derivation.parameter_rounding: Round each selected half-spread upward to the next 0.01 basis point.
derivation.normal_reason: The symbol-specific p75 exceeds the median while remaining representative of observed small-order quote crossing.
derivation.stress_a_reason: The symbol-specific p95 and a second five-minute fill-delay bar represent materially worse spread and timing.
derivation.stress_b_reason: The symbol-specific p99 and a third five-minute fill-delay bar form a deliberately severe observed-spread and timing scenario.
limitations: Quote evidence measures displayed spread, not queue position, partial fills, price improvement, order latency, or market impact.
The scenarios are valid only for retail-sized SPY/QQQ orders whose size does not create material market impact.
Quote-age statistics measure source-state freshness and do not calibrate broker order-to-fill latency.
A later mismatch with the applicable Alpaca account fee arrangement invalidates this model instead of changing it after strategy results.

regulatory_fees.account_assumption: Direct Alpaca Securities retail account without a partner commission or Alpaca Elite Smart Router fee.

brokerage_commission.invalidation: Any applicable partner or Alpaca Elite commission invalidates this frozen model.

sec_transaction_fee.formula: ceil_cent(rate * sum(executed sell notional for the account day))

finra_trading_activity_fee.formula: ceil_cent(sum(min(rate * sum(executed sell shares for the trade), maximum_per_trade) for each sell trade in the account day))

finra_cat_fee.formula: ceil_cent(rate * sum(executed absolute shares for all fills in the account day))

regulatory_fees.rounding: Aggregate each fee type for one account day, then round that fee type upward once to the nearest cent.
regulatory_fees.application: Derive the account day from each aware execution timestamp in America/New_York. Deduct the three rounded fee totals at the session boundary before carrying cash and equity into the next session.
